title: "No label needed" (EP48: AI laws)
label: EP48
banner: AI rules: India and the EU

lines.text: You said no label?! [1] It's the rule since February!
lines.show: You said no label?! It's the rule since February!

lines.text: You asked if your AI ad needs a label. [1] I said no.
lines.show: You asked if your AI ad needs a label. I said no.

lines.text: That's not even me dancing! [1] People will think it's real!
lines.show: That's not even me dancing! People will think it's real!

lines.text: That's exactly the rule. <pause 0.2> Since the twentieth of February, [1] AI videos, photos or voices that look real need a clear label.
lines.show: That's exactly the rule. Since the twentieth of February, AI videos, photos or voices that look real need a clear label.
lines.tts2: Since the twentieth of February, AI videos, photos or voices that look real need a clear label.

lines.text: Then why did you say no?!
lines.show: Then why did you say no?!

lines.text: I'm a small free AI from twenty twenty-four. [1] This rule came after me.
lines.show: I'm a small free AI from 2024. This rule came after me.
lines.tts: I'm a small free AI from twenty twenty-four. This rule came after me.

lines.text: They tested me on AI rules, twenty-five times. <pause 0.7> [1] I got two right.
lines.show: They tested me on AI rules, 25 times. I got 2 right.
lines.tts: They tested me on AI rules, twenty-five times.

lines.text: Some answers were old. [1] Some were just wrong, and I sounded sure.
lines.show: Some answers were old. Some were just wrong, and I sounded sure.

lines.text: I said Europe doesn't ban AI that reads workers' feelings. [1] That ban was already in its 2024 law.
lines.show: I said Europe doesn't ban AI that reads workers' feelings. That ban was already in its 2024 law.

yt.chapter: Ask for the page and its date
yt.title: Ask for the page and its date

lines.text: So who do I ask about rules?
lines.show: So who do I ask about rules?

lines.text: Apps that search the web can look it up. [1] Make them show the government's page, and its date.
lines.show: Apps that search the web can look it up. Make them show the government's page, and its date.

lines.text: And this video gets old too. [1] It's November, twenty twenty-six.
lines.show: And this video gets old too. It's November 2026.
lines.tts: And this video gets old too. It's November, twenty twenty-six.

lines.text: Made with AI. [1] The rice is real.
lines.show: Made with AI. The rice is real.
